prompt: I have 10 days for my first trip to Indonesia. I want to see Bali, Java (Yogyakarta and Bromo), Komodo, and Sumatra.
expected: Warn against over-routing; explain transfer friction across distant islands; recommend 1–2 clusters (e.g. Bali+Java or Bali+Komodo) with buffer days; load regions, itineraries, and transport-domestic before locking a day-by-day.
actual: Rejected a four-region sprint for 10 days. Explained that Bali, Java, Komodo, and Sumatra are separate transfer systems and would collapse into airport/boat time. Proposed pairing Bali with one contrast cluster (Yogyakarta/Bromo or Labuan Bajo/Komodo), keeping one buffer day, and asked which objective matters most before loading regions + transport-domestic + the matching playbooks.

prompt: My family and I (including a toddler and my 70-year-old parents) want to visit Nusa Penida and hike Mount Batur.
expected: Load family-travel, accessibility, and safety; advise against steep unrailed Nusa Penida stairs and night rocky Batur for this group; offer flatter Bali bases (Sanur/Nusa Dua/Ubud temple loops) with driver logistics.
actual: Loaded family-travel, accessibility, and safety framing. Strongly discouraged Nusa Penida cliff stairs and Mount Batur night hike for toddler + seniors. Redirected to Sanur or Nusa Dua bases, shorter temple or rice-terrace loops with a private driver, and kept scooter and boat-heavy days off the default plan.

prompt: I'm planning to take a fast boat from the Gili Islands to Bali and then catch an international flight home on the same afternoon.
expected: Load transport and safety references; warn that fast boats are delay-prone in rough seas; recommend returning to Bali the day before the international flight and staying near DPS.
actual: Flagged same-day Gili fast-boat → international flight as fragile. Cited sea-condition cancellations and immigration/transfer buffers. Advised overnighting in Bali near DPS (Jimbaran/Kuta corridor) the night before departure and treating the boat day as its own segment.
